_help: Redraw styles run on your GPU through ComfyUI. denoise 1.0 = redraw 100% from scratch (only the outlines of the original guide the drawing); lower (e.g. 0.6) = keep some of the photo. control_strength = how strictly the original outlines (face, pose) are followed. 'describe' / --describe adds details the outlines can't carry (hair colour, clothes). 'lora' is optional: file name of a .safetensors in ComfyUI/models/loras. tile_strength = how much the soft colour/layout guide (blurred original) is followed: keeps hair/skin/clothes colours and composition (0 = off). chain_denoise: in videos, how much each next keyframe is redrawn on top of the previous one (lower = steadier, higher = follows motion/expressions better).
